new_page.h1: Buying a Home in the Township of Langley: The Rules
new_page.title: Township of Langley Home Buying Rules: Zoning and Suites
new_page.description: Township of Langley rules for buyers: zoning, small-scale housing, the 120 m² suite cap, coach houses, community plans, servicing and tax dates, with sources.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Rewritten November 11, 2026 in plain words from the sourced rules on the Township of Langley guides; the official sources are listed at the bottom.

The Township of Langley runs from Willoughby’s new streets to farms in the Agricultural Land Reserve. Langley City, in the middle, is a separate municipality with its own bylaws. These are the Township-wide rules, with the Township’s sources at the bottom.

items.t: Zoning is Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500. Get the parcel’s zone from the Township or its GeoSource map first.

The Official Community Plan and the community plans sit on top. The Willoughby Community Plan is now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025), and updates to it went to Council in 2026, so check where they stand for a Willoughby lot. Rural land is under the Rural Plan.

Subdivision goes through the Township’s Approving Officer, under Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw 2019, No. 5382. Confirm roads, water, sewer or septic and drainage for the specific application.

blocks.text: Small-scale housing, suites and coach houses

items.t: Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) allows three units on eligible lots of 280 m² or less and four units on larger eligible lots up to 4,050 m². Lots over 4,050 m² aren’t eligible, and there is no six-unit tier in the Township.
A secondary suite in the Township can be up to 120 m².
A coach house is a second home on the same fee-simple lot and title as the main house. It is not a strata lot and can’t be sold on its own.
On low-lying land, flood status affects insurance and lending. Ask the Township about the lot before you remove subjects.
ALR status is set parcel by parcel on the ALC’s map, and it decides what you can build or split on a rural lot.
In a housing co-op, the co-op approves the buyer and you buy a share, not a strata lot. Its own rules decide who can live there; the strata 55+ exemptions don’t automatically apply.

Township 2026 taxes and utility fees were due July 2, 2026, with 5% added to current-year taxes unpaid at midnight July 2 and another 5% at midnight September 3. Utility fees are now billed separately from taxes.

The unit count you plan against Bylaw 6020 and the lot size.

faq.q: How big can a suite be in the Township of Langley?
How many units can I build on a Township of Langley lot?
faq.a: Under Bylaw 6020, three units on eligible lots of 280 m² or less and four on larger eligible lots up to 4,050 m². Bigger lots aren’t eligible, and there is no six-unit tier.
